purpose: Reveal the hidden economic price of ordinary human behavior through one readable contradiction.
required_elements: one readable human decision or reaction

default_visual_system.name: finance-board
default_visual_system.reference_role: Image 1 and dominant style and layout-density reference for every prompt
default_visual_system.paper_ground: bright white or warm off-white paper with a faint gray blueprint grid and light pencil texture
default_visual_system.header: top quarter to third, mandatory four-to-nine-word uppercase heavy black topic statement or complete curiosity/consequence question in no more than two lines, one thin terracotta-red underline; never a one-word or elliptical short-fragment headline
default_visual_system.hero: one detailed coherent central transaction environment with a readable human decision embedded inside it and characters smaller than the system
default_visual_system.margin_callouts: four to six short handwritten economic labels in separate white edge zones, each with a thin charcoal arrow and short terracotta underline
constraints: shared visual grammar only, never a competitor's exact composition or branded asset
dense coherent detail in the center, clean white callout zones at the margins
detailed hand-inked 2D editorial subjects and objects with bold charcoal contours, restrained watercolor-like fills, subtle pencil hatch, and slight paper grain
no glossy product rendering, volumetric 3D shading, dramatic perspective, realistic skin, sparse icon bubbles, or floating icon soup

cross_channel_rule: Toss blue must appear in every thumbnail; olive and terracotta remain HumanPrice semantic accents.
